_about: Which pieces of the running app become components in the Photoplan design system. `from` is the title of a capture in design/build-reference.js; the preview is that capture's real markup (a static rendition — there is no component library to run). `guide` becomes components/<name>/README.md: first sentence = the summary.

components.name: Button
components.subtitle: Primary, paper, action, danger, dashed, quiet link, round
components.guide:
Buttons are square, bordered in `ink`, and labelled in `label-button`: a verb and its object, shown in capitals.

- **Primary** (`green` fill, `paper` text): the one thing the view is for — at most one per group of buttons. **Paper** (`paper` fill, `ink` text) for everything else in a header.
- Header buttons are `control-nav` tall with `offset-md`; they move 1px up-left on hover and 2px down-right when pressed.
- **Action buttons** in a card's footer are `control-action` tall and flat: filled green for the done state, outlined for the rest.
- **Danger** is outlined in `danger-line` with `danger` text and fills with `danger` only on hover. Keep it at the far end of the footer, away from the other actions.
- **Dashed** buttons (`line-dash`, `chip` text, lower case) add something optional: “+ show tides here”.
- **Quiet links** (`label-link`, 1px underline) are for switches that are not part of the task: night mode, hide controls.
- A glyph may lead the label, `gap-icon` away. Never use a glyph alone unless the button is round or a stepper, and then give it a title.

Static rendition of the site's own markup: supply the label, the glyph and the action.

components.name: Chip
components.subtitle: Kit, links, region, trip, area
components.guide:
Chips hold one short fact or one link, `chip-h` tall, padded `chip-y` `chip-x`, with square corners.

- **Plain chips** (`sunken` fill, `line-chip` border, `ink-2` text): kit, areas, tags. They are not buttons unless they say so with a ↗ or a hover border.
- **Link chips** take `green` text and end with ↗ when they leave the site.
- **Trip pills** are slate (`slate-wash`, `slate-line`, `slate-ink`) with the ▲ glyph and `offset-sm`: they open the trip.
- **The region badge** is `green` for UK and `terra` for International, outlined, and fills on hover for the owner.
- **Condition chips** (`green-wash`, `green` border, `green-deep` text, weight 600) appear only when a day suits that kind of shoot.
- One fact per chip. If it needs a sentence, it is not a chip.

Static rendition of the site's own markup: supply the text and, for links, the address.

components.name: Field
components.subtitle: Search, select, date, text, click-to-edit
components.guide:
Fields are `field`-coloured boxes with a 1px border and square corners; text is mono for data and Spectral for sentences.

- The **search field** and the **month picker** are `control-nav` tall with an `ink` border and `offset-md`, so they sit level with the nav buttons.
- **Selects** keep the native control with the arrow restyled; the year picker is the quiet one — a dotted underline beside the title, no box.
- **Date and text inputs** in a card are `control-sm` tall with a `line-strong` border. On focus the border turns `green` with `ring-field`.
- **Click-to-edit text** looks like plain text until hovered; while editing it takes a `field` background, `radius-3` and a 2px `focus-ring-strong` ring, and saves when focus leaves.
- Placeholders are in `ghost` and say what to type: “paste latitude, longitude”.
- Labels sit to the left in `label-row`, never inside the box as its only label.

Static rendition of the site's own markup: supply the value, the placeholder and the label.

components.name: Checklist
components.subtitle: Ticked, open, add row
components.guide:
A checklist is a column of 16px tick boxes with a line of `prose-item` each: shots to get, things to pack.

- A ticked item turns its box `green` with a `paper` tick and strikes its text through in `label`.
- The last row is a dashed box and a field with a dashed underline; it adds an item on Enter.
- A × appears at the end of a row on hover to remove it.
- Without edit rights the list shows only the items — no add row, no ×.
- A count (“1 of 2”) sits under the row's label in `micro`.

Static rendition of the site's own markup: supply the items and whether each is done.

components.name: Masthead
components.from: Masthead, tools and the home nav column
components.subtitle: Home page header
components.guide:
The home page's header: the mark and wordmark, a one-paragraph intro, the tool buttons under it, and to the right the way into the first month, the year, the legend and the quiet switches.

- The mark and `wordmark` sit top-left and are the only large branding on the site.
- The intro is `prose-intro` in `ink-3`, at most about 70 characters a line.
- Tool buttons are paper buttons in one wrapping row, ending with the search field.
- The right column is right-aligned and stacked `grid-gap` apart; on phones it moves under the intro and aligns left.

Static rendition of the site's own markup: supply the intro text and the year.

components.name: PageHeader
components.subtitle: Title, year, nav row, tool row
components.guide:
Every page below the home page opens the same way: the small lockup, the `title-page`, a line of intro, the nav row to the right, then a hairline and a row holding search and the quiet switches.

- The lockup above the title links home.
- On a month page the year sits beside the title as a quiet picker with a dotted underline.
- The nav row runs: page-specific controls, a thin divider, the other pages as paper buttons, a divider, then the green Home button last.
- Keep to one green button in the row.

Static rendition of the site's own markup: supply the title, the intro and which pages to link.

components.name: SyncBanner
components.subtitle: Offline, or a save pending
components.guide:
A full-width notice above the header, shown only while the shared calendar cannot be reached or a save has not gone through.

- `alert-bg` ground, `alert-ink` text in mono, a `danger-line` border.
- One or two sentences saying what is wrong and what is paused, then a small paper button outlined in `danger` to retry.
- It is the only place a warning colour fills a strip of the page. Do not use it for success or for news.

Static rendition of the site's own markup: supply the sentence.

components.name: ComingUp
components.subtitle: The next events from today
components.guide:
A strip of small cards for the next events, soonest first, under a section label.

- Each card is `paper` with a 4px left edge in the event type's accent, `offset-sm`, a date line in `label-tag` style and the event's name in `name-tile` after its glyph.
- Something already under way reads “Now · until …” and comes first, in `green`.
- The strip scrolls sideways rather than wrapping; the section label's right end says how far ahead it looks.
- A card opens the month, the location or the trip it belongs to.

Static rendition of the site's own markup: supply the events (date, name, type).

components.name: MonthList
components.from: A month in the year list
components.subtitle: One month of “The year, month by month”
components.guide:
One month in the home page's list: on the left its number, name, one-line character and sunrise and sunset; on the right its locations.

- The month name is `title-month`; its line is `prose-note`-sized Spectral in `ink-3`; the light times are mono in `green`.
- Each location row has a region dot (`green` UK, `terra` International), its `name-list`, its subject tag in capitals, where it is, the idea in `prose`, and a “When” line.
- Rows are parted by `line-faint` rules and take a `paper-shade` wash with `radius-3` on hover; the whole row opens the location.

Static rendition of the site's own markup: supply the month and its locations.

components.name: LocationTile
components.subtitle: With photo, selected, empty
components.guide:
A location as a 170px tile: a 4px region bar, a 76px photo slot, then the subject tag, the name and the region.

- The bar and the dot are `green` for UK and `terra` for International.
- With no photo the slot shows diagonal stripes in `stripe` on `sunken` — never a grey box or an icon.
- The selected tile takes a 2px `ink` outline; on hover a tile lifts 3px.
- For the owner the photo carries round controls: a drag handle top-left, a tick (done) top-right and a star (this photo fronts the printed month) under it. Visitors see only a static tick on done tiles.

Static rendition of the site's own markup: supply the name, tag, region and whether there is a photo.

components.name: LocationBrief
components.subtitle: The shoot brief card
components.guide:
The card that opens when a location is chosen: everything needed to go and shoot it.

- A 5px bar across the top in the region's colour, then the subject tag, the name in `title-month` and the region badge; a square close button top-right.
- Left column: the photograph (3:2, `radius-4`), its year, further photos, the map coordinates and the map links.
- Right column: label-and-value rows in a fixed order — Where, Area, Idea, When, Shots, Visits, Trips, Light, Sky, Tides, Kit, Parking, Links, Notes — each `row-y` padded and parted by `line-soft`.
- Light and Sky are mono data with a day stepper; everything written is Spectral.
- The footer holds the actions: Completed (green when done), Schedule photo op, Move to…, and Delete at the far right.
- Visitors see the same card without the footer, the empty rows or the add fields.

Static rendition of the site's own markup: supply the location's fields; rows with nothing to show are left out for visitors.

components.name: CalendarGrid
components.subtitle: Month grid with bars, icons and legend
components.guide:
The month as a seven-column grid, Monday first, under a header strip with the month's typical light.

- The header strip is `paper-shade`; weekday initials are mono in `faint`; columns are parted by `grid-line` and weeks by `rule-week`.
- Day numbers are `data-day`, top-left of each cell.
- **Events are bars**: 19px tall, `radius-2`, the type's wash with a 3px accent edge, its glyph and its name in `event-bar`. A bar spans the days it covers and stacks in lanes.
- **Nature and season windows are icons**, not bars: one small picture in the top-right corner of every day they cover, in the accent colour, with no label.
- The legend under the grid names each type and each window with its dates; the owner's green “+ Add event” sits at its right end.

Static rendition of the site's own markup: supply the month, the year and the events.

components.name: TripCard
components.subtitle: Open, with dates, locations, shots, packing
components.guide:
A planned outing as a card: closed it is a header; open it shows the plan.

- The header has the ▲ glyph in `slate`, the name in `title-card`, a slate badge for when (“tomorrow”, “in 12 days”, “past”), the dates in mono, and at the right a summary of locations, shots and packing.
- Open, the card takes an `ink` border and a 6px offset shadow, and shows rows: Dates, Locations, Shots, Packing, Notes — with a 90px label column.
- Locations are bordered blocks with the name and the first day's sunrise and sunset; they open the location.
- Shots and Packing are checklists. Under Packing sit dashed helpers: “+ kit from these locations”, “untick all”, “reset to the usual list”.
- Delete trip is alone at the bottom right, in the danger style.

Static rendition of the site's own markup: supply the trip's name, dates, locations, packing list and notes.

components.name: GalleryGrid
components.subtitle: Tabs, group/filter/sort row, tiles
components.guide:
Every photograph in the calendar, grouped and filterable.

- Two tabs in `label-row`-sized capitals; the current one is `ink` with a 2px `green` underline.
- One tool row: a Group by select, the region filter as three joined buttons (the chosen one filled `green`), toggle buttons for Starred and Visited, then Year, Tag and Sort selects. All are `control-sm` tall. A count sits at the right.
- Each group opens with a `heading-group`, a hairline and its count.
- Tiles are 3:2 photographs in a `paper` frame with a `line` border and `lip-under`, the name in Zilla Slab 14px and a line of mono underneath (month, year, area, tags); a gold star badge marks the printed pick.
- A tile opens the photo viewer, which is dark in both themes.

Static rendition of the site's own markup: supply the photographs and their locations.

components.name: YearInReview
components.subtitle: Stat tiles, month strip, visit log
components.guide:
A summary of one year: what was visited and photographed.

- A row of stat tiles: a `stat` number over a `label-tag` caption, on `paper` with a `line` border.
- A twelve-column strip with two thin bars a month — visits in `green`, photos in `gold` — and the month's initial; a column opens that month.
- Then lists under `heading-group` headings: Most visited, Trips, the Visit log.
- Use `gold` and `green` here only as those two series; the pair differs in lightness as well as hue.

Static rendition of the site's own markup: supply the year's counts and lists.

components.name: ForecastDay
components.subtitle: Day card with “Promising for” chips
components.guide:
One day of the seven-day outlook, read the way a photographer needs it.

- A flat `paper` card with a `line-strong` border and `lip-under`, padded 13px 16px.
- Left: the weather symbol, the date in `heading-day` and a `caption` line with the outlook and the temperature range.
- Then four columns — Dawn, Dusk, Night, and Rain · wind · vis — each a small capital heading (with the time of sunrise or sunset), one mono `data` reading, and a `caption` verdict in `muted`. A verdict that promises colour turns `terra`.
- **Promising for** ends the card only when the day suits a kind of shoot: one condition chip per kind (“≋ Mist & inversions · dawn”). No suitable kind, no row.

Static rendition of the site's own markup: supply the day's readings and its flags.

components.name: GuideCard
components.subtitle: Conditions, settings, tips
components.guide:
A reference card for one kind of shoot: what conditions to look for and how to set the camera.

- `paper`, `line-strong` border, `lip-under`; a `terra` glyph and the title in `heading-card`.
- Three short blocks — Conditions, Settings, Tips — each a `label-row` heading over `prose-small`.
- When the forecast suits it, a line of mono in `green-deep` under the title lists the promising days (“Promising at Mam Tor: Thu 19 Nov (sunset)”).
- Cards sit two across (`gap-lg` apart) and one across on phones.

Static rendition of the site's own markup: supply the title, glyph and the three blocks of text.

components.name: Dialog
components.subtitle: One question, one field
components.guide:
A small dialog for one question with one text field: a name, or the edit password.

- 380px wide, `paper`, an `ink` border, `offset-dialog`, and a 5px `green` bar across the top; it sits over the `scrim`.
- A `label-section` title, a sentence in Spectral, the field, then a rule and the buttons right-aligned: Cancel (quiet outline) and the action (green), in that order.
- Enter confirms; Escape cancels.
- Never use the browser's own prompt or confirm boxes.

Static rendition of the site's own markup: supply the title, the sentence, the field's value and the action's label.

components.name: ConfirmDialog
components.subtitle: Irreversible action
components.guide:
The same dialog as a yes-or-no, for anything that cannot be undone.

- The top bar and the confirm button are `danger`; everything else is unchanged.
- The sentence names the thing and says plainly what is lost: “Its photos will be removed from the cloud as well. This cannot be undone.”
- The confirm button repeats the verb and the object (“Delete location”), never “OK” or “Yes”.

Static rendition of the site's own markup: supply the title, the sentence and the action's label.

components.name: EventEditor
components.subtitle: Title, days, type, shown as
components.guide:
The dialog for adding or changing a calendar event.

- 392px wide, with the top bar in the chosen type's accent and a live preview of the event's bar under the title.
- Fields in order: Title, Start day and End day side by side, Type, Shown as, then two checkboxes (printed; repeats every year).
- **Type** is a wrapping row of chips, each in its type's own wash, text colour and accent dot; the chosen one carries a small round tick. A dashed “+ New type” ends the row.
- **Shown as** offers Auto, Bar, or one of the window icons, as 30px buttons with `radius-2`; the chosen one is filled `green`.
- Footer: Delete (danger outline) at the left, Save event (green) at the right. Nothing is saved until Save.

Static rendition of the site's own markup: supply the event's title, days and type.

components.name: TripPopup
components.subtitle: A trip at a glance
components.guide:
A read-first pop-up for a trip, opened from its bar in the grid, a pill in a brief or a Coming-up card, so the reader stays on the page.

- 520px wide with a `slate` top bar; the same dialog frame as the others.
- Shows the name, the when badge, dates, the locations as chips, the shot list (tickable), a packing progress bar with what is still unpacked, and the notes.
- Footer: Close at the left, “Edit on the Trips page →” (green) at the right.

Static rendition of the site's own markup: supply the trip.

components.name: BackupsList
components.subtitle: List rows with paired actions
components.guide:
A dialog holding a list of saved copies, each with two actions.

- 560px wide; a paragraph of explanation, one paper button, then rows.
- Each row: the date in Zilla Slab, size in `micro`, and at the right Download (quiet outline) and Restore (danger outline). Rows take `paper-shade` on hover.
- Use this pattern for any list where each item has a safe action and a risky one: the safe one first, the risky one last and in the danger style.

Static rendition of the site's own markup: supply the rows (date, size).
